selGameSub: Run sub test suites (Database, API, Manage page) of specific game
full: Run all test case in main test suites
smoke: Run only smoke test cases in main test suites
p_full: Parallel run all test case in main test suites
p_smoke: Parrallel run only smoke test cases in main test suites
exportStatus: Sync the lastest execution result to google sheet
sendResultToTelegram: Send the latest execution result to user via Telegram

scripts.CI_SelGame_Smoke: cross-var mocha --timeout 0 Games/$npm_config_game/*_Test.js -r @babel/register --fgrep Smoke_ --file ./Setup.js --file ./Teardown.js --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=Report
scripts.selGame_Full: cross-var mocha --timeout 0 Games/$npm_config_game/*_Test.js -r @babel/register --fgrep Full_ --file ./Setup.js --file ./Teardown.js --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=Report
scripts.smoke: cross-var mocha --timeout 0 Games/**/*_Test.js  -r @babel/register  --fgrep Smoke_ --file ./Setup.js  --file ./Teardown.js  --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=Report
scripts.p_full: cross-var mocha --timeout 0 Games/**/*_Test.js -r @babel/register  --require ./configParallel.js Games/**/*_Test.js --parallel -j 3 --reporter mochawesome --require mochawesome/register --reporter-options reportDir=Report
scripts.p_smoke: cross-var mocha --timeout 0 Games/**/*_Test.js -r @babel/register  --fgrep Smoke --require ./configParallel.js Games/**/*_Test.js --parallel -j 3 --reporter mochawesome --require mochawesome/register --reporter-options reportDir=Report
